$comment: E182 — Tag/domain/evergreen defaults for Tier 0 lessons in ~/.claude/template-memory/. Used by scripts/memory/match.sh + inject.sh to rank lessons against the active SessionStart cue (branch name + git diff path prefixes + git status). File-level YAML frontmatter (tags, domains, evergreen) on the lesson file ALWAYS wins; this sidecar only fills the gap for lessons that have not yet been re-promoted by @memory-curator with E182 frontmatter. Manually curated. Resolution order: file frontmatter > this map by basename > empty.

branch_tag_cues.$comment: Branch-name regex → tags. Matched against `git branch --show-current` to seed the cue. Used in addition to git-diff path prefixes.

path_tag_cues.$comment: Path-prefix → tags. Matched against `git diff --name-only main`. Path prefixes are matched literally; a changed file `next-app/app/api/v1/endpoints/auth.ts` triggers all cues whose key it begins with. E363: rewritten to next-app/-relative paths (was server/, client/ from the pre-Next.js FastAPI+Vite split); `next-app/tests/`-style cues for `server/tests/`/`client/src/tests/` were dropped rather than faked — unit tests are colocated `*.test.ts` files throughout lib/ and actions/ with no single directory prefix to match, so next-app/e2e/ is the only precise equivalent kept below. server/app/domains/ (business-domain modules) and client/src/api/ (client-side API-calling layer) both collapsed onto next-app/actions/ (Server Actions) in this stack, so their tag sets were merged onto that one key.
